note: Coded attributes of the register's laws and policies that apply today and are marked as weighing on productivity (framework version 2, DECISIONS E-185). kind: what kind of obligation the rule is; when: when it bites (entry: before trading starts; growth: at the first employee or a size threshold; operating: while operating or on an activity); bound: whom it binds in the industries it reaches (all, or only those doing some activity); note: the basis, from the item's own summary and law.
